header.title: Profile & Security
header.lede: Personal details, password, active sessions, notifications, and account closure — all in one place.

profile.title: Profile
profile.localeHint: The language the platform shows you by default — independent of the language this page is currently open in.
profile.companyNamePlaceholder: As stated in your company's documents

security.changeSuccess: Password changed. We signed out every other session on other devices — this one stays signed in.
security.sessionsHint: Devices and browsers where your account is currently signed in.
security.signOutOthersConfirm: Every session except this one will be signed out. Continue?
security.signOutOthersSuccess: {count, plural, one {Signed out # session} other {Signed out # sessions}}

notifications.title: What we send
notifications.lede: Notifications about security, debt, and moderation decisions can't be turned off — they concern your account and your money.
notifications.unavailableSuffix: . While that's the case, emails and messages aren't sent — everything arrives in the Notifications section instead.

closeAccount.collapsedBody: Access ends immediately, on every device. Listings come off publication. You won't be able to undo this yourself.
closeAccount.reasonLabel: Reason — optional, but it helps us

closure.closedBody: Access has ended and the profile is hidden from the site. If this is a mistake, contact support.
closure.whatDoesNotBody: Deleting personal data isn't built yet, and that's deliberate: until it's settled exactly what the platform must keep and for how long, a half-finished deletion is worse than none — it looks complete when it isn't.
closure.debtWarning: You have an outstanding commission balance. Closing the account doesn't cancel it — and it doesn't block closing either: holding an account hostage over money would be pressure, not data protection.
closure.cannotCloseTitle: You can't close it right now
